 monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000\+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership\-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Our team is growing and we are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Professional Services team! In this role, you will deliver the technical solutions that embed the monday.com AI Work Platform within a customer's enterprise tech stack through integration, custom application development, and agentic AI engineering. You will work directly with our customers to transform solution designs into production systems on which their businesses depend. You will also contribute to the internal tooling that powers the speed, quality, and consistency of projects within our global delivery organization.
   

  

 Please note that this is a hybrid position with three days/week in our Atlanta office.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop deep, hands\-on knowledge of the monday.com platform, monday AI, products, and extensibility tools needed to fully integrate monday.com into clients' digital landscapes.
* Lead post\-sale technical delivery through discovery, technical requirements gathering, and the execution of technical services engagements, collaborating closely with account and deployment strategy teams.
* Lead technical consulting engagements for customers, applying industry knowledge in the areas of AI transformation, system scale, security, user governance, and data architecture.
* Engineer complex and agentic AI solutions that leverage our developer tools, including the monday.com API, MCP, and apps framework, to deliver data migrations, integrations, and custom applications.
* Navigate both complex engagements, where you execute defined technical scope within a delivery team, and standalone engagements, carrying customer communication, sequencing, and delivery yourself.
* Produce the documentation, walkthroughs, and exit artifacts for your builds that allow customers to operate, maintain, and extend them independently.
* Advocate for customers with Product and R\&D teams when their needs are not met and play an active role in extending monday.com product capabilities to help customers exceed their business goals.
* Contribute to the global Services tooling roadmap and shared asset library, building the internal utilities, reusable components, and reference implementations that make the next engagement faster than the last.


**Requirements**
* 3\+ years of experience as a forward deployed engineer, software engineer, or technical consultant in enterprise software, delivering hands\-on technical work for external customers in complex enterprise environments.
* Fluency in Generative and Agentic AI development, spanning LLM\-based workflows, agent orchestration and tool use, and context and retrieval design, with AI\-assisted editors such as Cursor or Claude Code in daily use.
* Familiarity with the practices that keep AI reliable once it is live, covering evaluation harnesses, guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop review, tracing, and the failure modes that only surface in production.
* Strong working knowledge of APIs (RESTful, GraphQL), webhooks, MCP, identity management (SCIM), and authentication protocols (SAML 2\.0/OAuth 2\.0\).
* Software development experience in TypeScript and JavaScript, with depth in either React or Node.js, and full\-stack experience being preferred.
* Hands\-on experience in enterprise data mobility and integrations, writing and adapting the SQL, scripts, and n8n or Workato automations that migrate and transform customer data into target systems.
* Exposure to production engineering concepts spanning version control, automated testing, CI/CD, and deployment to AWS, GCP, or Azure environments.
* Consultative range and communication skills required to understand a business problem, frame a solution for client stakeholders, and clearly articulate technical topics to a non\-technical audience.
* Adaptability to move between customers, technology stacks, and unfamiliar problem domains, with the resilience to absorb a change of direction mid\-engagement and genuine appetite for fast\-moving work.
* Detail\-oriented with some project management experience, comfortable running standalone engagements independently and working across several projects at once.
* Positive attitude, empathy, and high energy with the ability to take initiative and learn new technology to move where the work is.
* Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time.
* BS or BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience will also be considered.


 The estimated annual base salary range for this role is $140,000 \- $170,000\. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including education, training, experience, business needs, and work location. In addition to base salary, employees are eligible for either an annual discretionary bonus or a role\-based, sales incentive plan. Certain roles may also include equity in the form of RSUs. Full compensation details, including any applicable bonus or incentive plan, will be provided in the hiring process.
   

  

 monday.com offers a competitive benefits package, including comprehensive medical/dental/vision insurance, generous paid time off (vacation, holidays, personal leave and sick leave), fully paid parental leave, automatic 401(k) contributions, the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount (ESPP), and more. Full benefits details are available upon request. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis with no set deadline.
   

  

 Compensation Range: $140K \- $170K

Who is Quantium?
Quantium is a world leader in data science and artificial intelligence. Established in Australia in 2002, Quantium is a global team of more than 1,200 people across 14 locations with a unique blend of capabilities across product and consulting services to help businesses unlock value from data and analytics. Quantium partners with the world's largest corporations to forge a better, more intelligent world.
Product Analytics has embraced AI-native ways of working across our analytical workflows, and we're now moving from adoption to transformation — systematically advancing our analytical assets through an agentic maturity framework we designed ourselves.
The Role
As a Data Scientist you are curious, analytically capable, and excited about learning AI-native ways of working. You'll build upon your foundations in data science, Python, and SQL while learning to combine them with AI tools that are central to how our team operates.
How will you make an impact?
Apply Data Science methodology: including feature engineering, model development, and testing with attention to quality
Build AI-native analytical solutions: Move from simple AI assistance through to agentic workflows, contributing to our agentic maturity framework with guidance from senior team members.
Apply and critically evaluate AI outputs: Use AI tools daily to enhance your workflows and develop the skill of knowing when to trust, refine, or override what AI generates.
Contribute technically across the data lifecycle: Work across data extraction, cleaning, feature engineering, and model development using cloud platforms such as GCP, Azure, and AWS.
Design scalable, reusable approaches: Create specifications engineering teams can implement and build analytical solutions that can be applied across different business challenges.
Collaborate and share knowledge across teams: Work alongside analysts, engineers, and product specialists across geographies — sharing what you learn and contributing to AI-native practices.
Support delivery and continuous improvement: Contribute to project delivery, help resolve analytical questions, and suggest improvements to our processes, timelines, and methods.
The superpowers you’ll be bringing to the team:
1-5 years of experience in data science, AI/ML development, or technical consulting
Strong Python and SQL programming skills for data analysis and manipulation
Solid understanding of data science fundamentals: data preparation, modelling approaches, and validation methods
Familiarity with version control and documentation practices
Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Strong communicator — able to explain complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or similar) in your work or studies — or genuine enthusiasm and a clear willingness to learn
Understanding of ML/AI fundamentals including how LLMs work, transformer architectures, and when to apply different approaches
Remember – you might not tick all the boxes, but don’t let that from stopping you applying. We’re more interested in how you work, your ability to solve problems and think big.
What could your Quantium Experience look like?
Working at Quantium will allow you to challenge your imagination. You will get to solve complex problems using rigor, precision and by asking great questions – but it also means you can think big, outside the box and push your problem-solving skills to the max.
By joining the Quantium team, you’ll get to:
Forge your path: So many of our team have moved around different teams or offices. You’ll be in the driver’s seat, and we empower you to make your career your own.
Find your kind: Embrace diversity and connect with your tribe (think foodies, dog lovers, readers, or runners).
Make an impact: Leave your mark. Your contributions resonate, regardless of your role or rank.
But wait, there’s more!
We’ve got some pretty sweet perks:
Flexible work arrangements : Achieve work life balance at your own pace with hybrid and flexible work arrangements.
Continuous learning : Our vision is empowering analytics talent to thrive. The Analytics Community fosters the development of individuals, thought leadership and technical excellence at Quantium through building strong connections, fostering collaboration, and co-creation of best practice.
Remote working : Embrace the opportunity to work outside of your assigned home location for up to 30 days every year.
Apply now and let's forge a better, more intelligent world together!
